title: Dante's Inferno

achievements.reason: No Steam list: RAWG lists Xbox 360, Xbox One and PlayStation 3 (and a separate PSP entry), and the Steam store list has no app with this name, so steam=None. RAWG lists 55 trophies (RAWG's own percentages): story bosses and places (Acre, the Gates of Hell, Charon, King Minos, Marc Antony, Cerberus, Alighiero, the Gates of Dis, Heresy, Francesco, Beatrice, the Emperor of the Woeful Realm); relics, pieces of silver, Beatrice stones, Virgil commentaries and the 27 shades; Holy and Unholy levels; combos and kill counts; the Dark Forest; trials, community trials and uploads; and all trophies. These could seed an original checklist.

game.title: Dante's Inferno
game.blurb: Action-adventure from Visceral Games (RAWG also lists Electronic Arts), published by Electronic Arts, released 2010-02-05. RAWG average playtime: 23 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the trophy list on RAWG, with the story ordered by how many players unlocked each step.

chapters.title: Acre and the Gates of Hell
chapters.summary: The fight at Acre, breaking through the Gates of Hell and dealing with Charon.

chapters.title: King Minos to Cerberus
chapters.summary: Facing King Minos, Marc Antony and Cerberus, and the Gluttons along the way. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Alighiero to Heresy
chapters.summary: Defeating Alighiero, entering the lower circles through the Gates of Dis, and escaping Heresy. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Francesco to the End
chapters.summary: Francesco, saving Beatrice and the Emperor of the Woeful Realm. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Relics, Silver, Stones and Shades
chapters.summary: Holy and Unholy relics, the 30 pieces of silver, the 3 Beatrice stones, Virgil commentaries, the 27 shades to punish or absolve, fountains, and maxing the Holy and Unholy paths.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Hit combos up to 666, counters, magic kills and kill counts against minions, demons and other enemies.

chapters.title: The Dark Forest
chapters.summary: Completing the Dark Forest on any difficulty, and without getting lost once.

chapters.title: Trials of St. Lucia
chapters.summary: Trials, medals, ratings, uploads and two-player Lucia and Dante play, from the trophies RAWG lists. Needs a network connection for community trials, if the servers still run.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4700); RAWG also has "Dante's Inferno (PSP)" (id 5065) and "Dante's Inferno: Trials of St. Lucia" (id 42123, released 2010-04-29) as separate entries, which were not used for data. No Steam app (steam=None). The chapters come from the 55 trophies RAWG lists (RAWG's percentages, not Steam's); RAWG's detail reports 109 achievements, which does not match its 55-item list. The story order is our guess from those percentages (Acre 100%, Gates of Hell 85.6%, Charon 58.7%, King Minos 72.1%, Marc Antony 66.5%, Cerberus 64.2%, Alighiero 54.4%, Gates of Dis 52.5%, Heresy 51.5%, Francesco 50.4%, Beatrice 48.9%, the Emperor 47.6%), and the percentages are not strictly in order. The trials and community-trial trophies are put under the Trials of St. Lucia name because RAWG has an entry by that name and one trophy names Lucia; that they belong to it is not confirmed. Whether the Dark Forest is part of the main game or extra content is not in the data. StrategyWiki has a page under "Dante's Inferno" at completion stage 0 (its categories also list PlayStation Portable). Written subpages: Achievements and trophies (about 6,800 characters) and Table of Contents (about 340); Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. danteinferno.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; dantesinferno.fandom.com answers the API under "Dante's Inferno" with 9 linked articles (characters and weapons); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
